name: What kind of maintenance is required for different hardscaping materials?

mainEntity.name: What kind of maintenance is required for different hardscaping materials?

acceptedAnswer.text: Maintenance requirements for hardscaping vary by material. Pavers and natural stone generally require periodic cleaning and sealing to prevent staining and weed growth, maintaining their pristine appearance. Concrete, while durable, may benefit from occasional pressure washing and sealing to protect its surface. Understanding these differences allows homeowners to choose materials that align with their willingness to perform upkeep, and our team can provide guidance on best practices for preserving the beauty and longevity of your investment.
